answer: To keep the network honest, give every newcomer a small garden plot instead of a free account. Tending it means finishing one small verified task each day across a full cycle; only a tended plot yields a harvest token, and only that token pays the bridge toll into the main network. A vine binds each plot to one device: if two plots share a fingerprint, both vines wither and the harvest is forfeited. Plots can never be bought or transferred, so a Sybil farmer would have to tend dozens of gardens by hand, day after day, for one toll. Honest users simply garden once and cross the bridge.
